bienvenida.eslogan: Get and manage your insurance in minutes, with full transparency.

registro.terminos: I accept the terms of service and authorize the processing of my personal data.
registro.terminosTexto: We collect your name, ID, contact details and address to create your account and offer you insurance. We use your data to verify your identity, generate quotes and issue your policies. We don't share it with third parties unless required by law. You can ask us to correct or delete it at any time.
registro.debeAceptar: You must accept the terms to create your account.
registro.confirmarSalida: If you leave now, you'll lose your data.

verificacion.introduccion: We'll ask for a photo of your ID and a selfie. It's to confirm it's really you and fully activate your account.
verificacion.consejo3: Frame the whole document inside the box
verificacion.avisoDatos: These images are only used to validate your identity.
verificacion.instruccionDocumento: Center your ID inside the frame and make sure the details are readable.
verificacion.instruccionSelfie: Look ahead and verify that your face is completely focused.
verificacion.procesandoDetalle: This can take a few seconds.

resultadoVerificacion.detalleAprobado: Now you have access to all of our features
resultadoVerificacion.queHacer: Check that your ID is readable, find a brighter spot, and avoid glare before trying again.
resultadoVerificacion.soporteFueraDeAlcance: Contacting support isn't available in this test version.

motivo.documento_ilegible: The photo didn't let us read your ID clearly.

biometria.descripcion: Use your fingerprint or face to sign in faster next time.

ingreso.fueraDeAlcance: Password recovery isn't available in this test version.

consentimiento.introduccion: By authorizing access to your financial information, your premium is adjusted to your real profile and buying takes fewer steps.
consentimiento.finalidadDetalle: We use this information to calculate a premium adjusted to your real situation, instead of a generic rate.
consentimiento.vigenciaDetalle: The authorization lasts twelve months and renews automatically while it stays active.
consentimiento.avisoRevocable: You can revoke this authorization at any time, from this same screen.
consentimiento.elegirEntidadDetalle: The authorization is directed to the institution that currently holds your financial information. You'll be able to connect more institutions later: the more you connect, the more accurate your offer gets.
consentimiento.autorizo: I authorize access to my financial information
consentimiento.autorizoDetalle: By continuing, you authorize Solventa to access your financial information at the selected institution, according to the terms of this authorization.
consentimiento.faltanPasos: Choose an institution and turn on the authorization to continue.
consentimiento.conectandoDetalle: You'll be redirected to your institution to confirm.
consentimiento.activoDetalle: Your offer is already personalized with your financial information.
consentimiento.todasConectadas: You've already connected all the available institutions.
consentimiento.confirmarDetalle: We'll stop using your financial information. Your next quotes won't be personalized anymore.
consentimiento.avisoCotizacionVigente: Your current quote will no longer be valid.
consentimiento.desconectarDetalle: We'll stop using data from {entidad}. Your other connected institutions stay active.
consentimiento.ultimaEntidadDetalle: This is the last connected institution: removing it revokes the whole authorization.
consentimiento.sinConexion: You're offline: you can't connect or revoke the authorization right now.

inicio.kycEnCurso: We're verifying your identity. We'll let you know as soon as we have a result.
inicio.kycRechazado: We couldn't verify your identity. You can try again.
inicio.cotizarDescripcion: Pick an insurance type and build your quote in minutes.
inicio.polizasDescripcion: Check your active policies and their certificates.
inicio.consentimientoActivo: Authorization active: your offer is personalized.
inicio.consentimientoInactivo: Authorize the use of your financial data for a personalized offer.
inicio.biometriaDescripcion: Enable sign-in with fingerprint or face.
inicio.biometriaActiva: Sign-in with fingerprint or face is already on.
inicio.bloqueoRequiereKyc: You need to verify your identity first.
inicio.cotizacionInvalidada: Your quote is no longer valid: the conditions it was calculated with have changed. You can generate a new one.
